coordinate_conventions.coordinate_frame: USGS lunar Control Network (published feature-center coordinates)
coordinate_conventions.frame_resolution_status: The USGS feature records identify the Control Network and coordinate convention but do not state a DE421 frame realization. Verify and transform to MOON_ME/DE421 before combining with terrain or calculating geometry in Step 4.

surface_height_source.status: Planned source; sample each point and verify its datum and metadata in Step 4.

sites.name: Shackleton crater center (study point)
sites.coordinate_frame: USGS lunar Control Network (published feature-center coordinates)
sites.surface_height_source: NASA LOLA PGDA Product 90, LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.tif (planned; point elevation not yet sampled)
sites.coordinate_source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, feature 5450; center latitude/longitude as published.
sites.coordinate_provenance: USGS Gazetteer feature center; selected as a reproducible study point in the lunar south-pole region. It is not an Artemis landing-site coordinate.
sites.regional_context: NASA's 2022 Artemis III candidate-region map labels Peak Near Shackleton in the surrounding region; the crater center here is not that candidate landing region.
sites.instrument_height_assumption: 1.5 m is a study assumption, not a specified mission instrument height.
